case_title: HOWELL AMY H VS SOLAK CHUCK

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $200.00 FILED BY HOWELL AMY H AS TO DEFENDANT SOLAK CHUCK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-06-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 06

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HOWELL AMY H RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SOLAK CHUCK $200.00 PRINCIPAL, $8.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $208.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
